# Online Workshop: Containers

* **December 8, 2026**
* **4 - 5:30 pm ET (1 - 2:30 pm PT)**
* **Online (Zoom) [Registration Link Coming Soon]**

## Overview

This workshop will get you started with the [_Using containers for reproducible analyses_](https://www.opencasestudies.org/) case study, from the Open Case Studies Project. More details coming soon!

## Intended audience

This workshop is intended for biomedical researchers who wish to expand their data science skillset to using containers and plan to work through the [_Using containers for reproducible analyses_](https://www.opencasestudies.org/) case study.
